# imos_core — the sans-I/O protocol engine (plan §4.1). M1: codec (lossless
# XML model + message registry + legacy normalization), encoding engine,
# 2.8 stream deframer spike, session skeleton, and the IMessageStore
# interface with its in-memory reference. Nothing here opens a socket,
# spawns a thread, reads a clock, or touches a file.
#
# codec/gen/ and include/imos/codec/gen/ are GENERATED by
# tools/codegen/gen_messages.py and checked in; the codegen-verify test
# regenerates and diffs them against the DTD + annotations.

imos_add_library(core
  OUTPUT_NAME  imos_core
  EXPORT_BASE  IMOS_CORE
  SOURCES
    version.cpp
    codec/xml.cpp
    codec/xml_parse.cpp
    codec/message.cpp
    codec/legacy.cpp
    codec/story_body.cpp
    codec/gen/message_types.cpp
    encoding/encoding.cpp
    framing/deframer.cpp
    profiles/profile0.cpp
    profiles/profile1.cpp
    profiles/profile2.cpp
    profiles/profile4.cpp
    profiles/profile5.cpp
    profiles/profile7.cpp
    profiles/running_order_model.cpp
    session/in_memory_store.cpp
    session/peer_session.cpp
    session/reconnect.cpp
    session/time_format.cpp
    ws40/basic_auth.cpp
    ws40/url.cpp
  LINK_PRIVATE
    LibXml2::LibXml2
    ZLIB::ZLIB)
